title: Expose the shared committed-input reader as a store-independent JSON command
outcome: Install one read-only committed-input command before launchers migrate to it, removing the bootstrap cycle.
acceptance: `engram source --root <absolute worktree> --json` returns the jointly reviewed JSON v1 contract: version, clean/not_clean/unavailable status, canonical root when established, one git-commit source, tree metadata, bounded changed-porcelain entries from the same status read, and a bounded named refusal. Exit 0 means a completed clean or dirty measurement, exit 1 unavailable, exit 2 invalid invocation; exit 0 alone grants no credit.

The command dispatches before project/home/store/session resolution, reuses Engram's committed_input reader as the single predicate implementation, and performs rev 5 root commit, root and child filter guard, recursive submodule pin, one root status, and stable HEAD checks without deriving or buffering full file/index lists. It neither initializes, fetches, repairs nor mutates inspected repositories.

Existing deadline and output limits remain enforced (eight seconds and one MiB); a caller's supported shorter budget cannot increase them. Process failure, deadline, malformed Git output, unsupported input and root mismatch fail closed with a named reason. Trusted Git selection stays outside the inspected tree and inherited Git redirection remains isolated.

One reusable real-Git fixture constructor and expected verdict table lives in Engram for owner-command and later adapter conformance: clean, root/child dirty and untracked, off-pin/uninitialized, nested pinned children, root/child filters, child-local hiding config, ignored output, and the documented hidden-index-flag limitation. IDs and fingerprints are derived at runtime; command tests also cover refusal/exit semantics, root identity and store-independent operation.

No stored evaluation, verification, resolution or seal is rewritten or reinterpreted; existing live-currency callers retain the shared predicate and historical validators remain unchanged. This changeset does not migrate launcher fingerprints or launcher admission; those follow installation under the parent and separate fingerprint scope.

The command and fixtures pass the required exact-input review pair and FULL, relevant Windows checks and current readiness classification; the exact gated build is landed, pushed and installed under standing approval. The installed command's version/source identity is recorded, enabling a later separate launcher-migration changeset.

completion.summary: Delivered one store-independent committed-input JSONv1 command backed by Engram's shared reader, with bounded fail-closed output, real-Git conformance and exact Linux/Windows validation; landed, pushed and installed as 2d03fd4e8cbb9f2d1d1b34bc327cb170a04e3e3d.
